text:
Priya Patel: Quick design review — copy for the small inline permission help (console) reads a bit cold. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshot/perm-inline.png
Ethan: Saw this during QA. Current: "You don't have permission to view this page. Contact your admin." Feels abrupt.
Maya: Agree. Also accessibility: when this shows we need focus trap into the drawer and an aria-live announce.
Priya Patel: For copy I want something short, neutral, and with a clear next step. We have the Request Access flow wired so can prompt users to start that.
Ethan: Drafts (short):
- "Access restricted — Request access"
- "You do not have access — Request access"
Maya: Prefer avoiding contractions in the product strings (i18n). Also prefer a verb-first CTA label: "Request access to workspace" rather than "Contact your admin".
Alex (eng): Implementation note: the flyout is narrow on mobile, so one-liners only. The existing blue button already maps to /access-requests.
Sam (DesignBot): Microcopy checklist: 1) Primary action <= 3 words, 2) Tone neutral, 3) Provide reason only when available, 4) Avoid punctuation at end of concise messages.
Priya Patel: What about a subtle secondary reason line when we know it? Eg: "Reason: restricted to org admins" shown under the main line.
Maya: That works. Default: concise main line + action. Expanded: show reason. Screen readers should read both lines.
Ethan: Also suggest the action label be descriptive for assistive tech: "Request access to workspace" vs just "Request".
Priya Patel: OK here's a final set for mocks, please sanity-check:
```
Main: "Access restricted — Request access"
Action label: "Request access to workspace"
Secondary (optional): "Reason: restricted to org admins"
Code string form (no contractions):
Main: "Access restricted - Request access"
Action: "Request access to workspace"
Secondary: "Reason: restricted to org admins"
```
Maya: Tiny nit: on very small widths the em dash can break awkwardly. Try hyphen in code strings and run wrap tests.
Alex (eng): I'll test wrapping + aria-live behavior tomorrow. If space is tight we can shorten main to "Access restricted" and rely on the action label.
Sam (DesignBot): Localization flag: mark the secondary line as optional and avoid embedded punctuation in snippets fed to translators.
Priya Patel: Great. Ihanged strings in the mock and will upload updated artboard shortly. Thanks all ❤️
Ethan: :thumbsup:
Maya: Good one.
